Name: Emyn's Queer Dialogue Expansion
Author: yishaqeni
Description:
[b]Brief Overview

[/b]This mod is intended as a companion to my Pride March mods. It adds roughtly 4-5 queer-friendly dialogue lines to all characters except Krobus, Dwarf and the Ginger Island characters, gives some characters particular queer identities and supports queer or trans headcanons in the Stardew universe.

It adds some non-identity specific dialogue, such as characters referencing Pride and watching queer movies. Some references are obscurer than others. Demetrius specifically references queer scientists, while Elliott quotes queer poets. Alex references queer sports people in fall. Dialogue about Harvey's clinic references trans healthcare.

There's also a config file so you can turn off specific headcanons that don't gel with your playthrough.

[b]Requirements:

- [/b]Stardew Valley 1.5+
- Content Patcher 1.23.0+
- SMAPI 3.12.6+

Note this mod overwrites a few strings in Canon Friendly Dialogue Expansion.

[b]Recommended

[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9746]Emyn's Pride March[/url] by gwenynnefydd (me!) - adds a Pride event to Summer 1. This mod refers to character's getting ready for pride, but you'll need this mod if you want the actual event.

[url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/580603-diverse-stardew-valley-dsv-seasonal]Diverse Stardew Valley [/url]- this adds diversity to Stardew Valley, and has options to add sprites to support trans Sam and trans Penny dialogue.

[b]Install

[/b]Just drag and drop into your mod folder.

[b]Config Options

[/b]When you first start the game, CP will autogenerate a config for you. These are fairly self explanatory, however you can choose "true" for dialog you'd like to include, and "false" for ones you want to exclude.

Some characters reference the identities of others, however if you turn off the relevent toggle, these strings will also be removed. For example, if you set "TransSam" to "false", Kent, Jodi and Vincent will stop commenting on his transition.

You can also set all of these to false and still get some generic queer dialogue, but it will be harder to find.

 [spoiler] "BiAlex" - adds bi dialogue to Alex, removes sexuality confusion in 10 heart event
  "BiHarvey" - adds bi dialogue to Harvey
  "BiSebastian" - adds bi dialogue to Sebastian
  "BiLeah" - adds bi dialogue to Leah
  "BiMaru"- adds bi dialogue to Maru. Up until you have 7 hearts with either Maru or Penny, other characters will comment on a crush they have on each other.
  "BiGeorge" - adds bi dialogue to George, removed homophobia if you marry Alex
  "BiMarnie" - adds bi dialogue to Marnie
  "PanElliott" - adds pan dialogue to Elliott, Elliot will start quoting queer poets.
  "PanShane" - adds pan dialogue to Shane
  "PanAbigail" - adds pan dialogue to Abigail
  "PanHaley" - adds pan dialogue to Haley
  "PanLewis"- adds pan dialogue to Lewis
  "AceClint" - adds ace dialogue to Clint
  "AroAceLinus" - adds aroace dialogue to Linus
  "EnbyJodi" - adds enby dialogue to Jodi
  "EnbyWilly" - adds enby dialogue to Willy
  "TransSam" - enables trans dialogue for Sam
  "SamHasBinder" - adds references to binders for Sam. Requires "TransSam" to be set as "true"
  "TransPenny" - adds trans dialogue to Penny
  "BiPenny" - adds bi dialogue to Maru. Up until you have 7 hearts with either Maru or Penny, other characters will comment on a crush they have on each other.
  "TransWizard" - adds trans dialogue to the Wizard
  "IntersexEmily" - adds intersex dialogue to Emily
  "PanEmily" - adds pan dialogue to Emily
  "GayGus" - adds gay dialogue to Gus. Other characters will comment on him seeing a man during summer.
  "LesbianSandy" - adds lesbian dialogue to Sandy
  "PolyEvelynGeorge" - adds a line referencing an old poly partner
  "GenderNonConformingVincent" - adds GNC dialogue to Vincent[/spoiler]
